summary: Tucows Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into and termination of material agreements on July 27, 2026. The filing describes a Third Amendment to its credit agreement extending maturity from September 2027 to July 2029, while one lender's $27.5M commitment is being replaced. Additionally, Tucows entered into a Unit Purchase and Exit Agreement regarding Series A Preferred Units of Ting Fiber LLC, initially issued in a preferred financing. This suggests a strategic review of its Ting Fiber investment, potentially including divestiture or recapitalization. No deal terms were disclosed. Watch for details on the Ting Fiber transaction and lender replacement.
